title: aspilia helianthoides
intro: Aspilia helianthoides, commonly known as African tea or bitter leaf, is a tropical plant native to West Africa. It is a medicinal plant with various health benefits, including its use as a natural remedy for fever, diarrhea, and wounds, as well as its potential in the treatment of cancer and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Aspilia helianthoides are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Studies have shown that the bioactive constituents of Aspilia helianthoides may help to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation, and may have potential in the development of new medicinal products.
